name: Oncology Ventures
identity_check: Oncology Ventures, the cancer-care venture firm (Pulse 2.0 Fund II article: founder Ben Freeberg's firm, Texas Oncology as anchor investor; portfolio Risa, IgniteData, Tono, Concr). The lead's '$30M, 2024-08-26' is Fund I, not Fund II; Fund II ($62M) is the latest. Texas Oncology is the physician practice and anchor LP, not the investor (see texas-oncology.json). HCI Innovation Group calls the firm New York-based while Pulse 2.0 says Austin, Texas.
